description: Reveal-on-tap start-date field. Replaces the always-mounted 150pt DateTimePicker spinner. Collapsed it looks like a CategoryRow; tapping reveals an inline spinner (iOS) or opens the native calendar dialog (Android).

value.description: Selected start date; defaults to today (new Date())

open.description: Whether the inline iOS picker is revealed

onToggle.description: Toggle open/closed (iOS) or launch the dialog (Android)

behavior: iOS: onToggle reveals an inline DateTimePicker display='spinner' mounted only while open, inside the glass picker inset, fading in over animation.medium; collapses on next field tap or on scroll. Android: onToggle opens the native display='calendar' dialog; no inline spinner; the field label updates on dismiss. Chevron rotates up while open. Preserve existing handleDateChange semantics.

accessibility.label: Start date, {formatted date}, opens date picker
accessibility.colorIndependent: Open/closed conveyed by chevron rotation, not color
accessibility.reducedMotion: Reveal fade becomes instant under reduce-motion
